title: Sunday · Newport, 2 AM
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The 24-hour diner in Newport. Wood and the strip's Chloe at 2 AM. Thirty years of dialect. No exposition.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a 24-hour diner on 101 in Newport at 2 AM, wet-on-wet: the lit windows, the empty lot, one Legacy, one rental. Inside, two figures in a booth.

image.prompt: a 24-hour roadside diner at 2 AM in wet-on-wet watercolor, lit windows in a dark lot with an old Subaru wagon and a rental car, two figures in a booth seen through the glass

panels.name: The diner

panels.composition: Tier 2: the booth. CHLOE, thirty-eight, the pinned hair, the hollow drawn kindly. WOOD across, the flannel. Two coffees. A plate of fries between them, untouched.

balloons.text: I remember everything. It's the problem.

image.prompt: a woman with pinned dark hair and a man in a plaid flannel across a diner booth at night with two coffees and an untouched plate of fries, tired kind faces, watercolor

panels.name: Corn or peas

panels.composition: Tier 3: her hand on the table, the ring. His hand near it. The fries.

balloons.text: Thirty years of packaging for things nobody needed. Give or take.
It's been thirty, Wood. I count from the cafeteria.

image.prompt: close-up of two hands on a diner table not touching, a ring on one, a plate of fries, night

panels.name: Thirty

panels.composition: Tier 4: the diner from outside, later, the booth empty, two cars pulling out opposite ways. 3:40 on a clock through the glass.

image.prompt: the same diner from outside later with the booth empty and two cars pulling out of the lot in opposite directions, a clock reading 3:40 through the window, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Opposite ways

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: 'I count from the cafeteria.' The 2024 dock line rehearsed six years early.
